spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (स्फटति)
1 To open, to unfold, to burst.
2 To break or divide.

mf. (-टः-टा)
A snake's expanded neck or hood.
f. (-टी)
Alum.
E.
स्फुट to swell, aff. क, and the vowel changed to अ.

m. (-कः)
Crystal.
E.
स्फुट to expand, क्वुन् aff., and the vowel changed.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Crystalline, made &c. of crystal.
n. (-कं)
Crystal.
E.
स्फटिक the same, and अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
Crystal:
E.
see स्फटिक.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Crystalline, transparent.
E.
स्फटिक, and प्रभा light.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of crystal.
E.
स्फटिक, and मयट् aff.

m. (-लः)
Mount Kailāsa.
E.
स्फटिक crystal, and अचल a mountain.

m. (-दः)
Camphor.
E.
स्फटिकाद्रि Kailāsa, and भिद what breaks, what shames, being whiter.

m. (-श्मा)
Crystal.
E.
स्फटिक the same, and अश्मन् a stone.

(इ) स्फडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (स्फण्डति-स्फण्डयति)
To jest or joke with, to smile or laugh at.

r. 6th cl. (स्फरति)
1 To throb, to beat, to tremble.
2 To move.
3 To be manifest.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Large, great.
2 Loud.
m. (-रः)
1 Throbbing, quivering.
2 A bubble or flaw in gold, &c.
3 Twanging as of a bow-string.
E.
स्फर to throb, aff. घञ्, or स्फाय to swell, रक् Uṇādi aff., and the radical final rejected.

n. (-णं)
Throbbing, trembling.
E.
स्फर to throb, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-णं)
Throbbing, shaking, trembling.
E.
स्फर to throb, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

r. 6th cl. (स्फलति)
1 To throb, to beat, to tremble.
2 To move.
3 To be manifest.

m. (-लः)
Throbbing, quivering, trembling, shaking.
E.
स्फल to shake, घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A drop of water.
E.
स्फट to break, वुञ् aff.

n. (-लं)
Crystal.
E.
स्फाटिक the same, and उपला a stone.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Swollen, enlarged.
E.
स्फायी to increase, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 Increase, growth.
2 Swelling, intumescence.
E.
स्फाय to increase, क्तिन् aff., and the final rejected.

(ई) स्फायी r. 1st cl. (स्फायते)
To grow, to increase, to become large or bulky.

n. (-नं)
1 Shaking, quivering.
2 Rubbing, friction.
3 Rubbing or patting a horse.
E.
स्फल to shake, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Increasing, augmenting.
E.
स्फाय to increase, शतृ aff., वङ् inserted.
